translated_title: Hurricane 'Polo' Leaves No Fatalities in Baja California Sur; to Hit Guaymas, Sonora This Morning
original_title: Huracán 'Polo' dejó saldo blanco en BCS; pegará en Guaymas, Sonora esta mañana
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Alonso Urrutia
meta_description: Civil Protection says 6,700 evacuees are returning home as nearly 6,900 federal, state, and military personnel respond across the Baja California peninsula and Sonora.
